title: Gradient Time Series Configuration
description: Configuration for computing gradients over a time series using a sliding time window, with optional interpolation of missing values.

interpolate_missing.description: Whether missing data points in the time series should be interpolated prior to gradient computation.

data_frequency.description: Time interval of the time series expressed as a pandas Timedelta-compatible string. Required when interpolate_missing is enabled (e.g., '1D', '15min').

min_periods.description: Minimum number of observations in the sliding window required to compute a gradient.

sliding_window.description: Size of the sliding window expressed as a pandas Timedelta-compatible string used for gradient calculation (e.g., '7D', '1H').
